proposals.summary: Add a stadium-exit surge rule: hold Route 3 buses at Stadium Gate up to 60 s when the event is near and its queue is large, so departing buses fill before the fan surge.
proposals.rationale: Findings 1, 5 and 8 show Route 3 is the worst offender: 232 riders left behind at Old Main (queue peaked at 229), 59 left at Stadium Station, and Route 3 ran 96% empty while University Station queued 53 during class_change. The champion only spaces buses at the terminal (even-headway, 234 fires) and never holds at stops, so a full bus leaves Stadium Gate just before the surge and the next one is minutes away. Holding a Route 3 bus at Stadium Gate for up to 60 s when event_in_s is small and the local queue is large lets it absorb the first wave of fans, cutting left-behinds and downstream queue growth at Old Main without materially delaying riders already aboard (the hold is bounded by maxHoldS=60 and the 180 s per-loop budget). Changes: Add rule surge-hold-r3 at bus_at_stop: hold 60 s when event_in_s <= 120, queue_here >= 25, headway_behind_s >= 180, and route is r3 (via is_station==1 at stadium_gate); Keep allocation 2/2/2 and the even-headway terminal rule unchanged; Keep defaults (continue / dispatch / 45 s train dwell) unchanged.

proposals.summary: Rebalance buses toward the stadium-exit surge: 2/3/1 allocation, reassign idle buses to the busiest route, and hold Route 1/2 departures to meet incoming train transfers.
proposals.rationale: Route 3's Old Main queue peaked at 229 and left 232 riders behind during stadium_exit, while Route 3 also ran 96% empty during class_change; shifting a bus from r3 to r2 puts capacity on the apartments/downtown surge. Reassigning a bus at the terminal to the busiest route lets idle r1/r2 buses cover the r3 overflow without deadheading from Stadium Gate. Holding r1/r2 at Central for train arrivals reduces the 94 riders who reached Central just after Route 2 left, cutting missed connections and wait time. Changes: Changed allocation from 2/2/2 to 2/3/1 to favor the apartments surge and free a bus for reassignment; Added terminal rule to reassign a bus to the busiest route when its own queue is small and another route is much larger; Added stop rule to hold r1/r2 briefly at Central when a train with transfers is imminent.

proposals.summary: Hold buses briefly at stops when a train arrival is imminent and the stop is a rail station, and hold the train a little longer to let connection-bound riders board; keep the rest of the baseline.
proposals.rationale: The champion misses 633 connections and 1863 riders are left behind; findings 4 (94 riders missed r2 at Central right after the train) and the station queues at Old Main/Stadium/University show train-bus transfers are the dominant loss. A short, bounded station-stop hold for imminent train arrivals recovers riders who would otherwise just miss the bus, while a slightly longer train dwell (60 s) lets late bus arrivals feed the train. These are small holds well under the 15-minute service-gap limit and leave non-station stops untouched, so J should fall without starving other stops. Changes: Add a bus_at_stop rule holding up to 45 s at rail-paired stops when train_eta_s <= 60 and expected_transfers >= 8; Raise trainDefaultDwellS from 45 to 60 to absorb connection-bound riders; Keep terminal even-headway and default continue/dispatch.
